subject: Hosted API renewal + commit uplift for Marketly
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Alex Morrison <alex@marketly.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Hosted API renewal proposal + commit uplift

Hi Alex —

Following our call last week, attached is a concise renewal proposal that aligns with Marketly's higher traffic profile for next year. Summary highlights: 
- Monthly hosted API commit: 1.2 T tokens -> 2.0 T tokens (30% discount band applies at this threshold)
- New usage tiers: add a mid-tier at 500M/month to smooth overages and allow burst headroom
- Rate limits: base RPS unchanged; we recommend a burst window to 1.5x for 90s to cover peak campaigns
- One-time onboarding credit: $12k applied to first invoice if signed by 7/25

I've attached a short SOW + pricing addendum (Marketly_Renewal_Proposal_2028-07.pdf). If this looks good, I can prepare a DocuSign and loop procurement.

Next steps: please confirm 1) commit level, 2) whether procurement needs any additional language for data residency or logs retention.

Thanks —
Soojin Lee
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0142

Attachment: Marketly_Renewal_Proposal_2028-07.pdf (proposal PDF, pricing table)

From: Alex Morrison <alex@marketly.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Jul 2028 08:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosted API renewal proposal + commit uplift

Hi Soojin —

Thanks for the clear summary. A few quick clarifications from our side: 
1) Burst window — can we get explicit guarantees on latency during the 1.5x burst? We run timed ad auctions and spikes must not add more than +50ms p50.
2) Overages — how will we be billed if usage exceeds the 2.0 T commit in a month? We want predictable ceilings for budgeting.
3) Procurement will need a PDF SOW and a DocuSign envelope. Can the SOW include our legal tag lines (we'll send the required wording today).

I'll loop procurement (procure@marketly.com) once we have a final DocuSign link.

Best,
Alex
Head of Platform, Marketly
alex@marketly.com

---
Procurement note: marta.vega@marketly.com is the contracting lead; cc if you need to engage finance.

Date: Mon, 16 Jul 2028 11:02:00 -0700

FYI, forwarding Alex's clarifications — procurement + latency questions. Quick asks: 
- Ben: are we comfortable holding p50 latency SLAs for bursts? Can we offer a commitment for p50 +50ms for the 90s burst window, conditioned on using the same model family (e.g., rdx-large) and enabling prefix caching?
- Laura: pricing concession ask — Alex signoff is likely if we can waive the overage surcharge for the first two quarters while they ramp to steady state. Suggested concession: waive 10% overage surcharge for Q1/Q2 post-renewal, keep per-token overage rate as listed otherwise.
- Aditya: can you outline any ops notes we should include for implementation (KV cache warmup, model pinning recommendations)?

Quoted message below for context.

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Jul 2028 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Hosted API renewal proposal + commit uplift

Soojin — quick thoughts from pricing/AM side: 
- Latency guarantee: we can commit to p50 +50ms for the 90s burst window if customer agrees to two operational constraints: 1) pin to rdx-large family; 2) enable prefix/KV caching on their routes. Add to SOW as an operational precondition.
- Overages: propose the following billing: 
  * Up to 2.0T tokens — covered under commit at negotiated rate.
  * 2.0T–2.4T (buffer) — billed at 80% of standard overage rate (grace buffer).
  * >2.4T — standard overage rate plus normal surcharge.
- Concession: approve waiving the 10% overage surcharge for the first two billing cycles after renewal, provided they keep commit >=1.8T during that period.

If Laura signs off on the concession and Aditya confirms ops notes, we should close this week. I can draft the DocuSign with the concession language.

-Ben
Senior Account Manager, Redwood Inference

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Jul 2028 10:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Hosted API renewal proposal + commit uplift

Thanks team — ops notes for SOW (to be included as an appendix):
- Model pinning: rdx-large family recommended for all high-throughput endpoints; fallback to rdx-medium when queue depth exceeds threshold.
- KV cache warmup: we recommend a 48-hour warmup window after cutover; enable prefix caching for campaign IDs to reduce cold-token cost.
- Throttle policy: maintain base RPS as before; burst gating at 1.5x for 90s tied to per-route token budgets.
- Observability: include a dedicated alert for kv-cache hit-rate < 70% and token burn > projected 125% day-over-day.

I will attach a short ops appendix to the SOW for Procure.

-Aditya
Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Alex Morrison <alex@marketly.com>, Procurement <procure@marketly.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Jul 2028 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Final terms and DocuSign link — Marketly renewal

Alex / Marta —

Thanks for the quick turn. Per internal agreement, here are the final terms we will include in the DocuSign envelope: 
- Commit: 2.0 T tokens / month, 12-month term (auto-renew), monthly billing
- Pricing: as per attached pricing addendum; 30% discount band at the 2.0T commit level
- Overages: 0–2.4T billed at 80% of standard overage rate (buffer). >2.4T standard overage + surcharge.
- Concession: waive the 10% overage surcharge for the first two billing cycles if commit >=1.8T for those cycles.
- Latency: p50 +50ms guarantee during 90s 1.5x burst window, conditioned on rdx-large pinning and prefix caching (ops appendix attached).
- Onboarding credit: $12k applied to first invoice if DocuSign returned by 7/25/2028.

DocuSign link: https://www.docusign.net/signing/1234567890abcdef
Attached: Marketly_Renewal_Proposal_2028-07.pdf; Ops_Appendix_Markedly_2028-07.pdf

Please review and let me know if Marta needs any additional legal wording; Ben will prepare the invoice template after signature.

Cheers,
Soojin
